verdicts.reason: A scatters the three flavour pills with no logic: Cucumber Mint floats above the headline, Blood Orange sits beside the CTA, and Honey Rosemary drifts at the bottom. The SOLSTICE wordmark is blown up and pushed below the headline, so the reading order and grouping are broken. B at least keeps the pills in one central stack above the CTA, but they have very uneven widths (Honey Rosemary is oversized), and the order is changed. The left-aligned text block clashes with the centred pill column, the copy is jammed against the wordmark, and the stack is cramped vertically. Both need rework, but B is less chaotic.
